title: Sparse eras.json rows become valid empty advance targets
detail: A sparse eras table is padded with zero rows; advance validation checks only table length, so a missing intermediate era becomes a valid target with an empty unlock roster.
recommended_fix: After parsing, require every index to be populated (`cat.eras[i].era == i+1`, non-empty roster), and have `era_advance_validate` reject rows whose stored era does not match the target.

title: Validated demand_era binding is bypassed by runtime era indexing

detail: The loader validates roster membership against `demand_era`, but runtime demand resolves by `state.era`; a mismatched row passes validation while executing a different demand signature.
recommended_fix: Require `demand_era == era` at load, or route flow/crisis/forecast/health demand lookups through the validated `Era_Row.demand_era` binding consistently.
